## Section 4: Covenant Summary and Compliance


### 4.1 Financial Covenants

The Credit Agreement is dated December 15, 2022. [D2, header]. It contains three financial covenants. [D2, §7.1–§7.3].

- **Maximum Total Leverage Ratio.** "The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio, as of the last day of any fiscal quarter, to exceed 3.75 to 1.00." [D2, §7.1].
- **Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio.** "The Borrower shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio to be less than 1.20 to 1.00 as of the last day of any fiscal quarter." [D2, §7.2].
- **Minimum Excess Availability.** "The Borrower shall not permit Excess Availability to be less than $1,000,000 at any time." [D2, §7.3].

The leverage and DSCR covenants are tested quarterly [D1, §7]. Excess Availability applies "at any time" [D2, §7.3].

The Total Leverage Ratio is Total Funded Debt on the last day of the fiscal quarter divided by EBITDA for the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended. [D2, §1.1]. The Debt Service Coverage Ratio is EBITDA minus Unfinanced Capital Expenditures minus cash taxes paid (including Permitted Tax Distributions), divided by scheduled payments of principal and interest on Total Funded Debt, including interest on the Revolving Loans. [D2, §1.1].

Excess Availability is the lesser of the Revolving Commitment and the Borrowing Base, minus Revolving Loans outstanding. [D2, §1.1]. The Revolving Commitment is $10,000,000. [D2, §2.1(b)].

### 4.2 Reporting Covenants

The Borrower must deliver the following. [D2, §7.4].

| Deliverable | Timing | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Annual audited financial statements | Within 120 days after fiscal year end | [D2, §7.4(a)] |
| Internally prepared quarterly financial statements | Within 45 days after the end of each of the first three fiscal quarters | [D2, §7.4(b)] |
| Compliance Certificate, showing the Total Leverage Ratio and Debt Service Coverage Ratio | With each annual or quarterly delivery | [D2, §7.4(c)] |
| Borrowing Base Certificate | Within 20 days after the end of each calendar month | [D2, §7.4(d)] |

### 4.3 Negative Covenants and Default Triggers

**Negative pledge.** The Borrower shall not create, incur or permit to exist any Lien on its assets, except Permitted Liens. [D2, §7.5(a)]. Permitted Liens are:

- Liens in favor of the Lender.
- Liens securing Capital Lease Obligations, "limited to the vehicles and equipment subject to those leases."
- Purchase-money Liens securing indebtedness "not exceeding $500,000 at any time outstanding."
- Liens for taxes not yet due and payable.

[D2, §7.5(b)]. Fleet capital leases with Ridgeway Truck Finance were 3,420 at FY2025. [D1, §4, Fleet capital leases (Ridgeway Truck Finance), FY2025]. Most of the 52 delivery trucks are under capital leases. [D5, ¶1].

**Change of control.** The agreement states: "It shall be an Event of Default if the members of the Borrower on the Closing Date cease to control the Borrower, or if Dale Ostrander ceases to have primary responsibility for the operations of the Borrower and a successor reasonably satisfactory to the Lender is not appointed within a reasonable period." [D2, §7.6].

The relationship notes record the following. [D5, ¶1, ¶5].
- Ownership is Dale Ostrander 60%, Ruth Ostrander 20% and Megan Ostrander-Kolb 20%. [D5, ¶1].
- Dale Ostrander (67) plans to step back as CEO in mid-2027, and Megan Ostrander-Kolb is expected to take over day-to-day operations. [D5, ¶5].
- The family has discussed selling up to 30% of the membership interests to an employee stock ownership plan, with no timeline and no engagement letter. [D5, ¶5].

### 4.4 Compliance History

Figures are as reported in the borrower's compliance certificates. Q4 2025 is the FY2025 audited basis. Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 come from internally prepared quarterly statements. [D1, Table 3 note].

| Quarter | Total leverage (max 3.75x) | DSCR (min 1.20x) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 2025 | 3.00x | 1.33x | [D1, Table 3: Total leverage, DSCR; Q1 2025] |
| Q2 2025 | 3.22x | 1.28x | [D1, Table 3: Total leverage, DSCR; Q2 2025] |
| Q3 2025 | 3.41x | 1.22x | [D1, Table 3: Total leverage, DSCR; Q3 2025] |
| Q4 2025 | 3.20x | 1.27x | [D1, Table 3: Total leverage, DSCR; Q4 2025] |
| Q1 2026 | 3.23x | 1.25x | [D1, Table 3: Total leverage, DSCR; Q1 2026] |
| Q2 2026 | 3.38x | 1.24x | [D1, Table 3: Total leverage, DSCR; Q2 2026] |

Each certificate from Q1 2025 to Q2 2026 reported compliance with both financial covenants. [D1, §7]. Certificate dates: Q3 2025, November 14, 2025; FY2025, April 24, 2026; Q2 2026, August 12, 2026. [D1, §7].

The certificates do not report Excess Availability. [D1, §7]. Revolver availability was 3,100 at FY2023 and 2,400 at FY2024. [D1, Table 2: Revolver availability, FY2023, FY2024]. FY2025 revolver availability is "Not provided," because the December 31, 2025 Borrowing Base Certificate was not in the spread export. [D1, §2, Footnote *].

**Reporting waiver.** The Q2 2025 compliance certificate arrived 25 days late. Credit Administration waived the reporting covenant (waiver W-25-0388). [D5, ¶3]. All later certificates arrived on time. [D5, ¶3].

**Q3 2025 follow-up.** At the November 20, 2025 call, the CFO said the borrower does not plan to pay tax distributions above the members' estimated tax liability in FY2026. [D5, ¶4]. Permitted Tax Distributions are limited to the members' income tax liability attributable to the Borrower's taxable income. [D2, §1.1].

**Facility terms.** No change in the facility is proposed. [D1, Table 3 note]. [D5, ¶5]. The facility totals $14.0M, a $4.0M term loan and a $10.0M revolver. [D1, Table 3 note]. The Revolving Commitment terminates and all Revolving Loans are due December 15, 2027. [D2, §2.1(b)]. The Term Loan balance is due the same day. [D2, §2.1(a)].

### 4.5 Conflicts and Gaps

- **CONFLICT, FY2025 EBITDA.** The spread shows FY2025 EBITDA of 4,100. [D1, Table 1: EBITDA, FY2025]. The management commentary states: "EBITDA was about $4.5 million for the year." [D1, §6]. Both are reported. The covenant EBITDA definition is in D2 §1.1. The spread figure is the one used in the reported FY2025 leverage ratio. [D1, Table 3: EBITDA (TTM), Q4 2025].
- **Not in provided documents:** FY2025 revolver availability and Excess Availability at any date in FY2025 or 2026. The Borrowing Base Certificates would normally hold this.
- **Not in provided documents:** whether monthly Borrowing Base Certificates were delivered within the §7.4(d) timing. Credit Administration records would normally hold this.
- **Not in provided documents:** compliance with §7.3 for any period. The certificates do not report Excess Availability. [D1, §7].
- **Not in provided documents:** purchase-money Lien balances and any Liens outside the Permitted Liens. A UCC/lien search or the full agreement schedules would normally hold this.
- **Not in provided documents:** the membership of the Borrower on the Closing Date. The closing documents would normally hold this. D5 gives only current ownership. [D5, ¶1].
- **Not in provided documents:** the content of Schedule 1.1 (Eligible Inventory). [D2, §1.1].
- **Not in provided documents:** the dates of the Q1 2025, Q2 2025, Q4 2025 and Q1 2026 certificates, other than the three listed in D1 §7. Credit Administration records would normally hold these.

- Refer to legal the scope of "purchase-money Liens" and "Liens securing Capital Lease Obligations, limited to the vehicles and equipment subject to those leases" under §7.5(b).
